text:
Maya (CSM): heads-up — Lydian just uploaded their security/privacy questionnaire for renewal, deadline EOD Thu. Main asks: SOC2 report, DPA with EU residency, embeddings retention (PHI concern), BYOK/KMS options. Link to form: https://files.redwood.internal/lydian-q2-2026.pdf

onboard-bot: created ticket CS-8241 and added `customer-success`, `legal`, `security` tags

Ravi (SecEng): can you paste the exact embedding questions? quick sanity: do they want indefinite storage or deletion on request? are they asking for pseudonymization vs full deletion?

Tom (Onboarding): pasted Q12 — "How long are embeddings retained? Are they reversible?" they also highlighted examples that look like PHI. their free-text: "Indefinitely retained unless deletion requested."

Maya (CSM): @Ravi @Lena @Tom please triage — primary risk is they interpret hosted retention as permanent. we should offer a clear opt-in for analytics retention and a deletion API.

Lena (Legal): we can offer a DPA with EU SCCs and an addendum for KMS/BYOK language. I'll draft an addendum but need engineering text for how BYOK will work and exact deletion SLA to announce.

Ariel (Customer): Hi — thanks for the quick replies. For clarity: we only send pseudonymized patient IDs, but test uploads sometimes include deidentified PHI fields. For compliance we need: 1) BYOK or customer-key option, 2) confirming encryption at rest for embeddings, 3) deletion guarantee and verification, and 4) copy of the latest SOC2 Type II report.

Ravi (SecEng): short answers — encryption at rest: yes (AES-256). SOC2: we can provide a secure link to the report after an NDA. BYOK: supported on Dedicated and Private; hosted customers can be offered BYOK via our Enterprise KMS integration (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) but it requires contract addendum and provisioning. For retention/deletion: we can implement a deletion pipeline: remove from hot cache within 48h; mark for purge from long-term index and physical storage within 30 days; provide a deletion receipt. Need legal to sign off on wording.

Tom (Onboarding): proposed response for the form: 
```
- Default embeddings retention: 30 days (hot cache + short-term index)
- Optional extended analytics retention: 365 days (opt-in via contract)
- Deletion API: `DELETE /v1/customers/{id}/embeddings?confirm=true` — triggers removal from active service in 48h, full purge within 30 days; deletion receipt available via admin UI and audit log.
- BYOK: available on Enterprise/Dedicated/Private; sample bind call included below.
```

Tom (Onboarding): sample bind snippet: `POST /v1/admin/keys/bind {"customer_id":"lydian","kms_provider":"aws-kms","key_id":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef"}` (we'll sanitize before sending).

Lena (Legal): that draft looks good. I'll include: export control clause, data residency clause (EU SCCs), and KMS attestation language. will aim to have first pass EOD Wed.

Maya (CSM): action items: Tom — finalize the API wording + sample CLI for deletion; Ravi — prepare a short security attestation (SOC2 availability, encryption details); Lena — draft DPA addendum with BYOK/KMS clause. I'll confirm timeline with the customer and schedule a quick sync. standup 10:30 tomorrow to finalize reply. :thumbsup:

Ravi (SecEng): I'll also check ops on whether 30-day purge needs an ops play (snapshot retention, backups). will flag if any longer lead times.

Ariel (Customer): thanks — that timeline works. please include a copy of the deletion receipt format.

Maya (CSM) [next day follow-up]: legal sent draft to customer, they asked for a concrete SLA on deletion verification. Tom — can you propose exact fields for the deletion receipt?

Tom (Onboarding): propose receipt fields: `customer_id`, `object_type` (embeddings), `object_count`, `request_ts`, `completed_ts`, `purge_window_days`, `audit_log_id`, `operator_contact`. i'll mock an example and attach to the reply.

Lena (Legal): updated draft includes deletion SLA language: verified purge within 30 days with signed receipt; we redlined the BYOK attestation. awaiting Ravi's final sec blurb.

Ravi (SecEng): final sec blurb: "Redwood Inference maintains AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit, SOC2 Type II report available under NDA; BYOK binds customer master keys to tenant key encryption keys and prevents Redwood session-level access to plaintext model cache. Deletion pipeline removes hot/cache artifacts within 48h and purges persistent storage within 30 days; backups are rotated and immutable snapshots beyond purge window are addressed in our backup policy (see attached)."

Maya (CSM): perfect — sending to customer now. closing loop here; will update CS-8241 once customer confirms. thanks team :white_check_mark:
